No option can be put forward yet: the model compared prices, but could not test your churn limit or whether £20k MRR is reached.

- “Monthly churn < 4%” was left unscored because churn is modelled as a calculated change, not a monthly percentage level; its threshold frame is also unspecified.
- The £20k/month MRR threshold likewise cannot be aligned to the model’s change-from-origin outputs because no current MRR baseline is recorded.
- The comparison held up under the tested variations, but it rests largely on provisional Olumi estimates. The most structurally influential assumption is the Pro subscriber base; its source is an Olumi inference, not user evidence.
